risk_summary: The disclosure quantifies severe COVID-19 effects, including a $5.2 billion revenue decline, reduced capacity, negative operating cash flow, and reliance on more than $5 billion of new capital and government support. Management presents liquidity and cost actions as stabilizing factors, but recovery timing, demand, regulatory restrictions, and business travel remain materially uncertain. Use of adjusted metrics and promotional resilience language may soften the presentation of underlying operating and leverage risks.
